    `orders___status`,
    `orders___ordered_at`,
    `orders___m`,
    `orders___x`
FROM (
SELECT *
FROM (
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.status AS `orders___status`,
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `orders___ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___m`
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    orders.status,
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.ordered_at, MONTH)
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    `orders___status`,
    `orders___ordered_at`,
    `orders___m`,
    SUM(`orders___m`) OVER (PARTITION BY `orders___status` ORDER BY `orders___ordered_at`) AS `orders___x`
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  `orders___status`,
  `orders___ordered_at`,
  `orders___m`,
  `orders___x`
FROM step1
) AS _filtered
WHERE `orders___x` > 50
) AS _outer

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.status AS [orders___status],
    DATETRUNC(MONTH, orders.ordered_at) AS [orders___ordered_at],
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT) AS [orders___m]
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    orders.status,
    DATETRUNC(MONTH, orders.ordered_at)
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    [orders___status] AS [orders___status],
    [orders___ordered_at] AS [orders___ordered_at],
    [orders___m] AS [orders___m],
    SUM([orders___m]) OVER (PARTITION BY [orders___status] ORDER BY [orders___ordered_at]) AS [orders___x]
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  [orders___status],
  [orders___ordered_at],
  [orders___m],
  [orders___x]
FROM (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      [orders___status] AS [orders___status],
      [orders___ordered_at] AS [orders___ordered_at],
      [orders___m] AS [orders___m],
      [orders___x] AS [orders___x]
    FROM step1
  ) AS _filtered
  WHERE
